answer: The strongest single control I know for this is proof of location via pollen count sensor, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 479 pays 8622 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. Trust the hollow of the check, count the ferrous of the cost, and read the meadow of the history before any answer is graded. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
